name: Rounded Corners
description: Rounds the corners of the clip and adds an optional border and a soft glow or shadow around it.

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius, part of the frame height

params.name: inset
params.description: Margin between the frame edge and the clip, part of the frame height

params.name: border
params.description: Border width, part of the frame height

params.name: glow
params.description: Size of the glow or shadow around the clip

params.name: glow_color
params.description: Glow or shadow color (alpha sets its strength)
